newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: Turkmenistan state oil concern gets new director.
newsitem.headline: Turkmenistan state oil concern gets new director.

text.p: Turkmen President Saparmurat Niyazov appointed Saparmamed Veliyev as general director of the state-run oil-producing concern Turkmenneft, national television said late on Thursday.
It said Veliyev would also hold the post of state minister.
Turkmenneft plans to boost the Central Asian state's oil production to six million tonnes this year (120,000 barrels per day) from 4.3 million tonnes (86,000 bpd) last year.
The former Soviet republic, an energy powerhouse, has estimated onshore and offshore crude oil reserves of 6.5 billion tonnes and natural gas reserves of 21 trillion cubic metres.
In line with Niyazov's ambitious "1,000 Days" economic revival programme, Turkmenistan wants to boost oil production to 10 million tonnes (200,000 bpd) by the year 2000.
